name: Bromoketamine
summary: 2-Bromodeschloroketamine (also known as 2-Br-2'-Oxo-PCM and bromoketamine) is a chemical compound of the arylcyclohexylamine class, which is an analog of the dissociative anesthetic drug ketamine in which the chlorine atom has been replaced with a bromine atom. Its specific pharmacological activities have not been studied.

uses.text: 2-Bromodeschloroketamine (also known as 2-Br-2'-Oxo-PCM and bromoketamine) is a chemical compound of the arylcyclohexylamine class, which is an analog of the dissociative anesthetic drug ketamine in which the chlorine atom has been replaced with a bromine atom. Its specific pharmacological activities have not been studied. It has been sold online as a designer drug.

summaryZh: 2-溴去氯氯胺酮（英語：2-Bromodeschloroketamine），即溴胺酮（英語：bromoketamine），又稱2-Br-2'-Oxo-PCM、2-BDCK等，是一種芳基環己胺類化合物。它是解離性麻醉藥氯胺酮的結構類似物，但其中的氯原子被溴原子取代。
summaryZhHans: 2-溴去氯氯胺酮（英语：2-Bromodeschloroketamine），即溴胺酮（英语：bromoketamine），又称2-Br-2'-Oxo-PCM、2-BDCK等，是一种芳基环己胺类化合物。它是解离性麻醉药氯胺酮的结构类似物，但其中的氯原子被溴原子取代。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the arylcyclohexylamines, can cause confusion, poor coordination, nausea, vomiting, raised blood pressure and feeling detached from the body.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的芳基環己胺可能造成混亂、協調變差、噁心、嘔吐、血壓升高與身體脫離感。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的芳基环己胺可能造成混乱、协调制差、恶心、呕吐、血压升高与身体脱离感。

fact.en: It is ketamine with bromine in place of chlorine, and the bromine has also moved to a different spot on the ring. Both changes matter: in this family, the position of the halogen decides much of the activity.
fact.zh: 它是把氯胺酮的氯換成溴的產物，而且溴的位置也移到環上的另一處。這兩項改動都很重要：在這個家族中，鹵素的位置決定了大部分活性。
fact.zhHans: 它是把氯胺酮的氯换成溴的产物，而且溴的位置也移到环上的另一处。这两项改动都很重要：在这个家族中，卤素的位置决定了大部分活性。
